messages:
alex: Kicking off the SA edge routing tilt at 21:00 UTC. Will move 15% -> 50% over 20m windows. tagging @diego @maria for smoke + rollback readiness
maria: thanks. I can be around for the 21:00 window. what's the rollback plan?
diego: I'll run health probes + error-rate watch. Rollback plan: cut weights back to 0% for sa-region in route controller, and revert DNS TTL to 30s. Can do within ~2m, confirm.
leo: I'll watch infra alarms and have a small scaling bump ready in case of backpressure. Deploy-bot will post canary results.
rebecca: quick ask — are we using the new ttl of 60s or keeping 30s? We tested 60s with cache warming but prefer 30s for faster recovery.
diego: use 30s. also verifying certs; no cert rotation needed.
deploy-bot: Canary run started. canary_id=canary-2024-07-31-01. Initial sample: 5k requests/min.
alex: canary looks healthy at +5m. Latency p50 +10ms, errors steady. Proceed to 15% at 21:10 UTC.
maria: smoke check: login flow + docs generation passed. no SLO alerts.
diego: noticed a small spike in 429s from one backend instance — draining it now.
leo: draining ok. i'll watch queue depth.
alex: moving to 50% now. tagging @rebecca to confirm external partner endpoints.
rebecca: partner endpoints ok. small retry increase on their side but within tolerance.
deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 50% complete. no critical regressions.
alex: final step: set global route weights and lower TTL to 30s. after 10m of steady metrics we'll close.
maria: i'll stay for 30m post-rollout. FYI I updated the runbook with the rollback commands.
diego: rollback commands in runbook: `./routectl set-weight sa-east1 0` and `./dnsctl set-ttl sa.example.com 30` + revoke route in edge-proxy.
leo: if we see >2% error increase or p99 latency +200ms -> rollback.
alex: agreed. thanks everyone. ping me if anything odd.
rebecca: :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Rollout finished. status=success. final_traffic=50%. metrics: errors +0.2%, p99 +12ms.
